update brand
name = #{name},
create_time = #{createTime},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT b.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.brand_name = b.name AND p.is_deleted = 0) AS productCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r LEFT JOIN product p2 ON r.product_id = p2.product_id WHERE p2.brand_name = b.name AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) AS reviewCount FROM brand b
and name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
ORDER BY b.id DESC
